items.title: Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: one time I was at a part of a show called “feature time” where he would let an artist come down front and play a ballad feature with the rhythm section. So I’m the saxophonist, piano, bass and Art, and I play a ballad.

ctx.x: Can you give me a specific example of something he might have done for taking care of business on the bandstand for instance?

On the bandstand it wasn’t so authoritative as opposed to maybe some general situations. I mean travel decisions had to be made. On the bandstand Art was supportive. Now for example if there was something that he didn’t like he wouldn’t tell you what to do, but he would say leave that aspect out.
